video_url_rule: a video_url is relative to app: play app + video_url (the local app on part A's code; the live app still runs the old league, so never point clips at it)
note: Synthetic data: invented players and clubs in the Regista League, generated by Regista. Every number is computed from the league's event streams and physical records; definitions follow the named provider's published rule, adapted to 30-minute matches where a threshold depends on match length.
evidence_rule: Evidence lists at most 10 items per metric per player, in match order (the engine API's default); 'total' is the full count. Items point into the player's 'moments' by index ('m') with the event's value toward the metric ('v': 1 for a count, the xG of a shot, the xT added by a move, ...). A metric built from several keys (a ratio's numerator and denominator, or a sum) lists each event once: 'keys' names them, an item's 'in' says which keys the event counts toward and 'v' its value for each, and 'total' counts events. Physical metrics' evidence is one value per match (no clip). A moment's 'minute' is the football minute (1-based, as Regista's clip labels count it).

shots.rule: FBref: .395 shots per squad game, times 3.35 squad games (club minutes / 90), rounded up

take_ons.rule: FBref: .5 take-ons per squad game, times 3.35 squad games (club minutes / 90), rounded up

aerials.rule: FBref: .97 aerial duels per squad game, times 3.35 squad games (club minutes / 90), rounded up

challenges.rule: FBref: .625 dribblers challenged per squad game, times 3.35 squad games (club minutes / 90), rounded up

attempts.rule: Regista: at least 10 attempts (FBref sets no attempt minimum for completion rates)

sot_faced.rule: Regista: at least 10 shots on target faced

sample.note: Small sample: a club plays 10 matches of about 30 minutes, so a qualified player's season is about 280 minutes (3.1 full matches). Per-90s and percentiles rest on that; a metric marked noisy cannot yet separate players in the same role over one season (split-half reliability, regista.season.reliability).

season.percentile_rule: FBref: the mean of the share of peers strictly below and at or below; inverted where lower is better; only qualified players (minutes, and attempts for a ratio) get one
season.noisy_rule: split-half reliability within a role below noise_r: one season cannot yet separate players on this metric (regista.season.reliability)

metrics.label: Goals
metrics.definition: Goals scored, penalties included.

metrics.label: Non-penalty goals
metrics.definition: Goals scored, penalty kicks excluded.

metrics.label: Shots
metrics.definition: Attempts to score, penalty kicks excluded.

metrics.label: Shots on target
metrics.definition: Non-penalty shots that score or are saved. Opta also counts shots blocked by a last-line defender; Regista's blocks carry no goal-line flag, so they are left out.

metrics.label: Shots on target %
metrics.definition: Shots on target / shots (penalties excluded).
metrics.min_attempts_rule: FBref: .395 shots per squad game, times 3.35 squad games (club minutes / 90), rounded up

metrics.label: xG
metrics.definition: Sum of the expected goals of every shot, penalties at 0.79. Regista's xG is the generator's chance quality from shot distance (and 0.79 for a penalty, FBref/Opta's figure).

metrics.label: Non-penalty xG
metrics.definition: xG of every shot except penalty kicks.

metrics.label: npxG per shot
metrics.definition: Non-penalty xG / non-penalty shots: average chance quality.
metrics.min_attempts_rule: FBref: .395 shots per squad game, times 3.35 squad games (club minutes / 90), rounded up

metrics.label: Non-penalty goals minus xG
metrics.definition: Non-penalty goals minus non-penalty xG: finishing above or below the chances' quality. Noisy over small samples.

metrics.label: Big chances
metrics.definition: Shots with xG of 0.30 or more, and every penalty. Opta tags big chances by judgement (a chance a player should reasonably score); Regista uses an xG threshold instead.

metrics.label: Average shot distance
metrics.definition: Mean distance from goal of non-penalty shots, in metres (FBref reports yards).
metrics.min_attempts_rule: FBref: .395 shots per squad game, times 3.35 squad games (club minutes / 90), rounded up

metrics.label: Penalties taken
metrics.definition: Penalty kicks taken.

metrics.label: Penalty goals
metrics.definition: Penalty kicks scored.

metrics.label: Assists
metrics.definition: The last completed pass by a teammate before a goal (within 8 s, Regista's generator).

metrics.label: Key passes
metrics.definition: Passes that lead directly to a teammate's shot, assists included, penalties excluded: the completed pass received at the start of the shooter's possession.

metrics.label: xA (xG assisted)
metrics.definition: The xG of the shots that the player's key passes led to.

metrics.label: npxG + xA
metrics.definition: Non-penalty xG plus xA: expected goal contribution.

metrics.label: Shot-creating actions
metrics.definition: The two offensive actions directly before a shot (completed live or dead-ball passes, successful take-ons, shots, fouls drawn, tackles and interceptions), inside the shooting team's possession; the shooter can earn credit.

metrics.label: Goal-creating actions
metrics.definition: As shot-creating actions, for the two actions before a goal.

metrics.label: Through balls
metrics.definition: Completed passes played between the defenders into space.

metrics.label: Crosses
metrics.definition: Balls from a wide area into the centre, attempted.

metrics.label: Crosses completed
metrics.definition: Crosses that reach a teammate.

metrics.label: Cross completion
metrics.definition: Crosses completed / crosses.
metrics.min_attempts_rule: Regista: at least 10 attempts (FBref sets no attempt minimum for completion rates)

metrics.label: Passes into the penalty area
metrics.definition: Completed passes and crosses from outside into the opponent's 18-yard box, set pieces excluded.

metrics.label: Crosses into the penalty area
metrics.definition: Completed crosses that end in the opponent's 18-yard box, set pieces excluded.

metrics.label: Passes
metrics.definition: Passes attempted, crosses included (set-piece restarts are separate events in Regista; the taker's pass after a restart counts).

metrics.label: Passes completed
metrics.definition: Passes that reach a teammate.

metrics.label: Pass completion
metrics.definition: Passes completed / passes attempted.
metrics.min_attempts_rule: Regista: at least 10 attempts (FBref sets no attempt minimum for completion rates)

metrics.label: Passing distance
metrics.definition: Metres travelled by completed passes in any direction.

metrics.label: Progressive passing distance
metrics.definition: Metres completed passes travel toward the opponent's goal; backward passes count zero.

metrics.label: Progressive passes
metrics.definition: Completed passes that move the ball at least 10 yards toward the opponent's goal line from its furthest point in the team's last six passes, or any completed pass into the penalty area; passes from the defending 40% are excluded. Measured in the team's attacking direction.

metrics.label: Passes into the final third
metrics.definition: Completed passes that enter the third nearest the opponent's goal, set pieces excluded.

metrics.label: Switches
metrics.definition: Passes that travel more than 40 yards of the pitch's width.

metrics.label: Passes under pressure
metrics.definition: Passes attempted under pressure (Regista's flag: an opponent within 3.5 m when the possession starts).

metrics.label: Passes under pressure completed
metrics.definition: Passes under pressure that reach a teammate.

metrics.label: Completion under pressure
metrics.definition: Passes under pressure completed / passes under pressure.
metrics.min_attempts_rule: Regista: at least 10 attempts (FBref sets no attempt minimum for completion rates)

metrics.label: Short passes
metrics.definition: Passes of 5-15 yards attempted.

metrics.label: Short passes completed
metrics.definition: Completed passes of 5-15 yards.

metrics.label: Short pass completion
metrics.definition: Short passes completed / attempted (5-15 yards).
metrics.min_attempts_rule: Regista: at least 10 attempts (FBref sets no attempt minimum for completion rates)

metrics.label: Medium passes
metrics.definition: Passes of 15-30 yards attempted.

metrics.label: Medium passes completed
metrics.definition: Completed passes of 15-30 yards.

metrics.label: Medium pass completion
metrics.definition: Medium passes completed / attempted (15-30 yards).
metrics.min_attempts_rule: Regista: at least 10 attempts (FBref sets no attempt minimum for completion rates)

metrics.label: Long passes
metrics.definition: Passes longer than 30 yards attempted.

metrics.label: Long passes completed
metrics.definition: Completed passes longer than 30 yards.

metrics.label: Long pass completion
metrics.definition: Long passes completed / attempted (over 30 yards).
metrics.min_attempts_rule: Regista: at least 10 attempts (FBref sets no attempt minimum for completion rates)

metrics.label: Passes from the defensive third
metrics.definition: Passes attempted from the third nearest the player's own goal.

metrics.label: Defensive-third passes completed
metrics.definition: Completed passes from the defensive third.

metrics.label: Completion from the defensive third
metrics.definition: Completed / attempted passes starting in the defensive third.
metrics.min_attempts_rule: Regista: at least 10 attempts (FBref sets no attempt minimum for completion rates)

metrics.label: Passes from the middle third
metrics.definition: Passes attempted from the middle third.

metrics.label: Middle-third passes completed
metrics.definition: Completed passes from the middle third.

metrics.label: Completion from the middle third
metrics.definition: Completed / attempted passes starting in the middle third.
metrics.min_attempts_rule: Regista: at least 10 attempts (FBref sets no attempt minimum for completion rates)

metrics.label: Passes in the final third
metrics.definition: Passes attempted from the third nearest the opponent's goal.

metrics.label: Final-third passes completed
metrics.definition: Completed passes from the final third.

metrics.label: Completion in the final third
metrics.definition: Completed / attempted passes starting in the final third.
metrics.min_attempts_rule: Regista: at least 10 attempts (FBref sets no attempt minimum for completion rates)

metrics.label: Touches
metrics.definition: Times the player touched the ball: Regista writes one touch record for every full 1.92 s a player holds the ball in a spell, and at least one (generator 0.7.1, touch_every_s); with spells of 1-4 s that averages one record per 2.4 s on the ball (before generator 0.5.0 one per 0.8 s, about twice FBref's count). Not FBref's Touches: compare players with each other, not with FBref.

metrics.label: Touches in the box
metrics.definition: Touches in the opponent's penalty area: touch records there, plus the touch that ends each carry into it (Regista places a possession's touch records where it starts). Counted from Regista's touch records, so not FBref's Att Pen: compare players with each other, not with FBref.
metrics.rule: Regista touch records in the box (after FBref Att Pen)

metrics.label: Passes received
metrics.definition: Completed passes the player received.

metrics.label: Progressive passes received
metrics.definition: Completed progressive passes (FBref rule) the player received.

metrics.label: Carries
metrics.definition: Times the player moved with the ball at his feet.

metrics.label: Carrying distance
metrics.definition: Metres moved with the ball in any direction.

metrics.label: Progressive carries
metrics.definition: Carries that move the ball at least 10 yards toward the opponent's goal line from its furthest point in the team's last six passes, or any carry into the penalty area; carries ending in the defending half are excluded.

metrics.label: Progressive carrying distance
metrics.definition: Metres carries move the ball toward the opponent's goal; backward carries count zero.

metrics.label: Carries into the final third
metrics.definition: Carries that enter the third nearest the opponent's goal.

metrics.label: Carries into the penalty area
metrics.definition: Carries that enter the opponent's 18-yard box.

metrics.label: Take-ons attempted
metrics.definition: Attempts to beat a defender while dribbling.

metrics.label: Take-ons won
metrics.definition: Take-ons that got past the defender.

metrics.label: Take-on success
metrics.definition: Take-ons won / attempted.
metrics.min_attempts_rule: FBref: .5 take-ons per squad game, times 3.35 squad games (club minutes / 90), rounded up

metrics.label: Nutmegs
metrics.definition: Take-ons won by playing the ball through the defender's legs.

metrics.label: Skill moves
metrics.definition: Step-overs, elasticos, drag-backs, roulettes and body feints that beat a defender.

metrics.label: Ball losses
metrics.definition: Actions that end the team's possession: failed passes and crosses, and possessions lost to a tackle, a dispossession or a touch out of play.

metrics.label: Fouls won
metrics.definition: Free kicks or penalties won after being fouled.

metrics.label: Penalties won
metrics.definition: Penalty kicks won.

metrics.label: Offsides
metrics.definition: Times caught offside.

metrics.label: Tackles won
metrics.definition: Tackles that win the ball (every tackle Regista writes wins it).

metrics.label: Dribbled past
metrics.definition: Times an opponent's take-on beat the player.

metrics.label: Ground duels as defender
metrics.definition: Tackles won plus times dribbled past.

metrics.label: Tackle success
metrics.definition: Tackles won / (tackles won + times dribbled past). FBref's Tkl% counts only dribblers tackled; Regista counts every tackle.
metrics.min_attempts_rule: FBref: .625 dribblers challenged per squad game, times 3.35 squad games (club minutes / 90), rounded up

metrics.label: Interceptions
metrics.definition: Opponent passes cut out.

metrics.label: Tackles + interceptions
metrics.definition: Tackles won plus interceptions.

metrics.label: Tackles + interceptions, possession-adjusted
metrics.definition: Tackles won plus interceptions per 30 minutes of opponent possession while the player was on the pitch (Wyscout's PAdj). Opponent possession is in-play time on the ball plus passes in flight to a teammate.

metrics.label: Pressures
metrics.definition: Closing down the player on the ball (Regista writes one per possession: the nearest opponent within 3.5 m).

metrics.label: Pressure regains
metrics.definition: Pressures after which the player's team wins the ball in open play (tackle, interception, loose ball or rebound) within 5 seconds.

metrics.label: Pressure regain %
metrics.definition: Pressure regains / pressures.
metrics.min_attempts_rule: Regista: at least 10 attempts (FBref sets no attempt minimum for completion rates)

metrics.label: Ball recoveries
metrics.definition: Loose balls secured.

metrics.label: Clearances
metrics.definition: Ball sent away from danger with no intended recipient.

metrics.label: Blocks
metrics.definition: Shots blocked by standing in the ball's path.

metrics.label: Aerial duels
metrics.definition: Contested headers, won or lost.

metrics.label: Aerial duels won
metrics.definition: Contested headers won.

metrics.label: Aerial duels lost
metrics.definition: Contested headers lost.

metrics.label: Aerial duels won %
metrics.definition: Aerial duels won / contested.
metrics.min_attempts_rule: FBref: .97 aerial duels per squad game, times 3.35 squad games (club minutes / 90), rounded up

metrics.label: Fouls committed
metrics.definition: Infringements penalised by a free kick or a penalty.

metrics.label: Yellow cards
metrics.definition: Yellow cards shown.

metrics.label: Red cards
metrics.definition: Red cards shown (second yellows included).

metrics.label: Shots on target faced
metrics.definition: Opponent shots that scored or were saved while the keeper was on the pitch. Penalty kicks are left out, as FBref leaves them out of Save% (they are counted apart: penalties faced, penalties saved).

metrics.label: Goals conceded
metrics.definition: Goals conceded while on the pitch.

metrics.label: Saves
metrics.definition: Shots on target saved, penalty kicks excluded (penalties saved are counted apart).

metrics.label: Save %
metrics.definition: Saves / shots on target faced, i.e. (SoTA - GA) / SoTA, penalty kicks excluded from both, as FBref's Save% does.
metrics.min_attempts_rule: Regista: at least 10 shots on target faced

metrics.label: Clean sheets (30-min matches)
metrics.definition: Full 30-minute league matches played without conceding. A clean sheet is far likelier over 30 minutes than over 90, so the count is not comparable with a Premier League keeper's.

metrics.label: Full matches
metrics.definition: Matches played from start to finish.

metrics.label: Clean sheet % (30-min matches)
metrics.definition: Clean sheets / full 30-minute matches played. Keepers here run far above the Premier League's rate because a match lasts 30 minutes: compare keepers with each other only.
metrics.min_attempts_rule: Regista: at least 3 full matches

metrics.label: Penalties faced
metrics.definition: Opponent penalty kicks while on the pitch.

metrics.label: Penalties saved
metrics.definition: Opponent penalty kicks saved.

metrics.label: Keeper passes
metrics.definition: Passes attempted by the keeper, goal kicks included.

metrics.label: Keeper passes completed
metrics.definition: Keeper passes that reach a teammate.

metrics.label: Keeper pass completion
metrics.definition: Keeper passes completed / attempted.
metrics.min_attempts_rule: Regista: at least 10 attempts (FBref sets no attempt minimum for completion rates)

metrics.label: Launch %
metrics.definition: Share of the keeper's passes longer than 40 yards, goal kicks excluded.
metrics.min_attempts_rule: Regista: at least 10 attempts (FBref sets no attempt minimum for completion rates)

metrics.label: Keeper average pass length
metrics.definition: Mean length of the keeper's passes in metres, goal kicks excluded (FBref reports yards).
metrics.min_attempts_rule: Regista: at least 10 attempts (FBref sets no attempt minimum for completion rates)

metrics.label: Distance covered
metrics.definition: Metres covered on the pitch, from the 10 Hz motion.

metrics.label: High-speed running
metrics.definition: Metres at 20-25 km/h (FIFA speed zone 4).

metrics.label: High-intensity distance
metrics.definition: Metres at 20 km/h or more (FIFA zones 4 and 5).

metrics.label: Sprint distance
metrics.definition: Metres at 25 km/h or more (FIFA zone 5).

metrics.label: Sprints
metrics.definition: Runs at 25 km/h or more held for at least 1 second.

metrics.label: High-intensity runs
metrics.definition: Runs at 20 km/h or more held for at least 1 second.

metrics.label: High accelerations
metrics.definition: Accelerations held for at least 1 s that peak at 3 m/s² or more.

metrics.label: High decelerations
metrics.definition: Decelerations held for at least 1 s that reach -3 m/s² or less.

metrics.label: Top speed (season)
metrics.definition: The highest speed reached in any match this season.

metrics.label: Top speed (typical match)
metrics.definition: The mean of the player's match top speeds, over matches with at least 10 minutes on the pitch.

metrics.label: Time walking
metrics.definition: Share of time on the pitch below 6 km/h.

metrics.label: xT added
metrics.definition: Expected threat added by completed passes and carries: xT at the end minus xT at the start, on a 12 x 8 grid fitted on this season (move and shoot probabilities, goal probability from the xG of shots there). Failed actions add zero.

metrics.label: xT added by passes
metrics.definition: xT added by completed passes and crosses.

metrics.label: xT added by carries
metrics.definition: xT added by carries.

metrics.label: On-pitch goal difference
metrics.definition: Team goals for minus against while the player was on the pitch.

metrics.label: On-pitch goals for
metrics.definition: Team goals while the player was on the pitch.

metrics.label: On-pitch goals against
metrics.definition: Opponent goals while the player was on the pitch.

metrics.label: On-pitch xG difference
metrics.definition: Team xG for minus against while the player was on the pitch.

metrics.label: On-pitch xG for
metrics.definition: Team xG while the player was on the pitch.

metrics.label: On-pitch xG against
metrics.definition: Opponent xG while the player was on the pitch.

team_metrics.label: Possession
team_metrics.definition: Share of both teams' in-play possession time (on the ball, plus passes in flight to a teammate).

team_metrics.label: Possession by passes
team_metrics.definition: Share of both teams' attempted passes.

team_metrics.label: Field tilt
team_metrics.definition: Share of both teams' passes attempted in their attacking third that the team made.

team_metrics.label: PPDA
team_metrics.definition: Opponent passes in their own 60% of the pitch per defensive action there (tackles, interceptions, fouls). Lower means a more intense press.

team_metrics.label: Direct speed
team_metrics.definition: Metres gained toward the opponent's goal per second of open-play sequence (a sequence is the team's run of possessions until the opponent has the ball or the game restarts).

team_metrics.label: Long-pass share
team_metrics.definition: Share of passes longer than 30 yards.

team_metrics.label: Set-piece xG
team_metrics.definition: xG of non-penalty shots within 14 seconds of the team's corner, free kick or throw-in, before the opponent has the ball.

team_metrics.label: Set-piece shots
team_metrics.definition: Non-penalty shots within 14 s of a set piece.

team_metrics.label: High turnovers
team_metrics.definition: Open-play sequences won (tackle, interception, loose ball) within 40 m of the opponent's goal.

team_metrics.label: Pressures
team_metrics.definition: Pressures on the player in possession.

pitch.frame: attacking left to right (x = length toward the opponent goal at x = length)
pitch.heatmap_rule: on-ball actions per cell (the touch-map events: touches, passes, crosses, carries, take-ons, shots, tackles, interceptions, recoveries and clearances), rows y (0 to width), columns x (0 to length), attacking left to right, the same grid as the profile page
